thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired PD-INC-3421 — GPU memory pressure detected on infer-west2a-12. Node reported repeated CUDA MMU faults and OOM signs. Severity: P1.

pagerduty: PD-INC-3421 acknowledged by alex (on-call).

alex: Looking. seeing repeated kernel logs: `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS` and `mmu: invalid pte` in node syslog. GPU mem usage at 98% across the pool.

mira: @alex any customer impact yet?

alex: Yes — internal canary and ~12% of infer requests are 5xxing or timing out. Some customers routed to fallback but latency spiked to ~1.2s p50 -> 3.8s p95.

raj: Logs from runtime: `Allocator::alloc: failed to reserve 1.2GiB - cudaMalloc returned error 2` repeated. Also KV cache evictions skyrocketed.

sam: Running quick mitigation: cordon node and start drain. Command: `kubectl cordon infer-west2a-12 && kubectl drain infer-west2a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force`

alex: Doing cordon+drain now. Will route new requests away from pool via routing policy `route: prefer: pool-b`.

incident-bot: Auto-scaler triggered +1 GPU instance in pool-b (estimate provisioning ~4m).

mira: Starting handoff — I'm joining as secondary pager. Oncall rotation: alex -> mira at 4512345750.

alex: Drain succeeded for stateful pods except `kv-cache` pod (stuck in terminating). Killed it manually: `kubectl delete pod kv-cache-7d9f --grace-period=0 --force`.

raj: Observed kernel backtrace snippet: 
```
mmu: bad pte, addr=0x7f9b3c000000
GPU 0: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS at infer-runtime.cu:1423
```
Suggests a driver-level corruption or bad GPU page mapping.

sam: Rerouted heavy customers to cpu-fallback pool and enabled reduced-batch mode for latency-sensitive flows. Added temporary throttle on prefetch to reduce KV churn.

mira: PD escalation status: PD still P1, notifying infra-sre for potential host-level reboot.

alex: Reboots planned for infer-west2a-12; will schedule after drain completes. Requesting approval to upgrade NVIDIA driver on that node if reboots don't clear MMU faults.

raj: Quick check: no other nodes in west2a show MMU faults yet, but mem fragmentation is high across the pool. Could be a model with bad alloc pattern.

mira: Noted. Ops-sre, can you confirm if host thermal events coincided? pinging infra-sre. :eyes:

incident-bot: infra-sre alerted.

sam: After reroute, 5xx rate dropped to 2.1% and p95 latency back to ~850ms. Traffic still degraded for customers hitting large-context models.

alex: Rebooting node now (soft reboot). Monitoring telemetry.

raj: If reboot doesn't clear, we should evict GPU driver + run diagnostics: `nvidia-bug-report.sh` and collect dmesg + nvml logs.

mira: Agreed. Also capture a sample of failing requests to link to postmortem evals.

incident-bot: PD-INC-3421 updated: on-call handoff to mira. PagerDuty note: primary acknowledged, secondary assigned.

sam: Reboot completed. Kernel messages show one remaining MMU fault then clear. GPU utilization normalized to ~60%. Marking node uncordon in 2min after health checks pass.

alex: Re-enabled node; traffic back to normal for most customers. Will keep throttles for large models for next 30m.

mira: Good recovery. Action items: (1) collect full nvml + dmesg bundle (owner: raj), (2) run targeted canary for large-model paths (owner: alex), (3) consider driver upgrade on maintenance window if diagnostics indicate corruption (owner: sam).

raj: Collected logs and uploaded to infra bucket. File: `s3://redwood-incidents/PD-3421/nvml-logs.tgz` (internal link).

mira: Closing PD while we keep monitoring. PD-INC-3421 status -> acknowledged -> resolved (follow-up checks ongoing). :thumbsup:

alex: Filing a short postmortem doc and linking the logs. Will include repro steps if we find a model-level alloc pattern.

incident-bot: PD-INC-3421 resolved by mira.

sam: Thanks team. If anyone sees MMU faults reappear, escalate immediately and route to spare pool.

mira: Copy. Will watch dashboards for 2h and then hand back to normal oncall.

alex: +1 — leaving note in runbook about temporarily reducing prefetch aggressiveness for large contexts.

(End of thread)
